example_sentences_in_bangla: দেবতা তার প্রতি বিমুখ হয়েছেন বলে মনে হচ্ছে।
এই কাজের পর সবাই তার প্রতি বিমুখ হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: It seems the deity has turned away from him.
After this deed, everyone has become displeased with him.
history: Refers to the concept of a deity turning away, common in Hindu-Bengali folklore and rituals.
note: Often used in contexts invoking divine displeasure.
